Transcript Requirements for Graduate Admission
Your experiences, goals, and hard work have brought you here. Submit your transcripts to continue your journey toward joining the University of Oregon community.
When you are admitted to the UO, you'll submit official transcripts to verify your degree(s) and academic records. This page explains what documents to provide and how to send them.
What to Submit
How to Send Official Transcripts
International Academic Records
Common Transcript Questions
Need help with your documents?
What to Submit
When You Apply
Submit unofficial transcripts for every post-secondary institution attended. You will submit these in the application portal.
Unofficial transcripts should show:
Coursework completed
Degrees earned (if applicable)
Degree conferral date (if applicable)
If your original documents are not in English, include a certified English translation.
After You are Admitted
Submit official transcripts from institutions where you earned a bachelor's degree or higher.
Official transcripts must:
Show the degree earned
Show the conferral date
Match the unofficial records you submitted in your application
Back to Top
How to Send Official Transcripts
Official transcripts can be sent to the UO's Office of the Registrar via electronic delivery or mail.
Electronic Delivery (fastest)
Send through approved secure providers, such as:
National Student Clearinghouse
Parchment
Scrip-Safe
Send to: registrar@uoregon.edu
PDF email attachments are not accepted.
Mailed Directly by Institution
Request your institution(s) send official transcripts to:
Office of the Registrar
5257 University of Oregon
Eugene, OR 97403
Student Mailed Sealed Transcripts
You may mail a sealed official transcript received from your institution. Do not open the sealed envelope.
Back to Top
International Academic Records
If you earned a degree outside of the United States, you may need to submit:
Official transcripts
Degree certificates
Certified English translations
Some institutions do not list degree conferral on transcripts. In those cases, a degree certificate is required.
If the UO cannot determine degree equivalency, you may be asked to provide a WES ICAP evaluation.
Suggested Translation Resources
Contact your embassy/consulate to determine if they provide this service
American Translators Association
University Language Services, Inc
Back to Top
Common Transcript Questions
My degree is still in progress: Upload your most recent unofficial transcript when applying. Submit your final official transcript after your degree is awarded.
I attended a School but did not earn a degree: Submit unofficial transcripts when applying. Official transcripts are only required from institutions where you earned a bachelor's degree or higher.
I Earned my Degree at the UO: You do not need to submit an official University of Oregon transcript.
Back to Top
Need Help with Your Documents?
If extenuating circumstances prevent you from obtaining official documents, contact the Division of Graduate Studies.
